name: Tanukichi
source:
A [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_raccoon_dog#In_folklore_and_tradition]tanuki[/URL] ayakashi. In order to be able to properly thank Haginosuke for rescuing him, Tanukichi practices shapeshifting with his younger sister, Tanue. He has a bright disposition and cares deeply for his little sister.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/ayakashi/chara_subB.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
